title: KAONO MAKA'N ME BARPA
body:
Maghmoom hain fazae'n, rota hai zarra zarra
Bechain hain hawae'n, aur kar rahi hain giriya
Har simt hai udaasi, har simt hai andhera
Chashme falak hai purnam, veera'n huwa Madina
<<MINI>>
Kaono maka'nme barpa Maatam hai Fatima ka
<<DIVIDER>>
Baade Rasule Akram, kya waqt aapada tha
Har lamha the masa'eb, dil tukde ho raha tha
Athaara saal ka sinn, aur haath me asa tha
Un aafato'nme jeena, Zehra ka Hosla tha
<<MINI>>
Kaono maka'n me barpa Maatam hai Fatima ka
<<DIVIDER>>
Sehti Rahi musibat, payham Nabi ki Beti
Karti thi Sabr har dam, Mazloom Shaahzadi
Pahlu shikista Bibi, khud pisti thi chakki
Duniya se Ja rahi hai, Khidmat me Mustafa ki
<<MINI>>
Kaono maka'n me barpa Maatam hai Fatima ka
<<DIVIDER>>
Ghurbat ka hai zamana, kaisi ye bekasi hai
Moula-e Dojaha'n par, uftaad ye nayee hai
Mushkil Kusha pa kaisi, mushkil ki ye ghadi hai
Tanhaai Murtaza ki aansu baha rahi hai
<<MINI>>
Kaono maka'n me barpa Maatam hai Fatima ka
<<DIVIDER>>
Dekha Janaza Maa ka, Rowe Hussaine Muztar
Aayi Sada-e Zehra, Ye Maa Nisaar Tujh par
Rona Tera gawara, kaise Karegi Maadar
Seene se Main Lagaloo'n, Aaja Hussain Dilbar
<<MINI>>
Kaono maka'n me barpa Maatam hai Fatima ka
<<DIVIDER>>
Zehra ka to Janaza, tareek shab me utha
Yaad aate hain Rasheed ab, Bazare Shaamo Kufa
Wo Betiya'n Ali ki, bechaadari ka charcha
Wo Aalame Aseeri, wo oont bekajawa
<<MINI>>
Kaono maka'n me barpa Maatam hai Fatima ka
author: Rasheed Shaheedi
